newsitem.title: USA: Texas Meridian was high bidder on 17 tracts.
newsitem.headline: Texas Meridian was high bidder on 17 tracts.

text.p: Texas Meridian Resources Corp said Tuesday it was the high bidder on 14 tracts in the State of Texas lease sale held April 1 and three tracts in the March 12 State of Louisiana lease sale.
In Texas, the company said, it acquired a 100 percent working interest in 11 tracts in Galveston Bay and a 50 percent working interest in three tracts.
Texas Meridian said it also acquired a 50 percent working interest in three tracts in the West Cameron area of Louisiana state waters.
It said the Galveston Bay tracts cover an extension of the Frio sand trend, which is the same sand that produces in the company's Chocolate Bayou Field in nearby Brazoria County.

Texas Meridian said it recently acquired rights to a 150 square mile 3-D seismic survey under a joint venture agreement with Southwestern Energy Co, whereby Texas Meridian will be the operator of 18 additional tracts in Galveston Bay. Exploratory drilling is expected to begin in this area during the second quarter.

The Louisiana tracts acquired are within the area of mutual interest established under the company's previously announced joint venture with Louisiana Land and Exploration Co, and are immediately south of Texas Meridian's East Cameron Field onshore in Cameron Parish.
